verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own tools to redact or remove sensitive data retroactively for GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance, which covers the deletion side of the story. It also offers controls over which events are saved, and a self-hosted On-premise edition for organizations that want to manage their own data. Missing for 10: any documented configurable retention period or automatic expiry policy, detail on deletion scope (per-user or per-project erasure, API-driven deletion), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
